title: Wall corner with a target tucked behind it
description: A ground Wall to the target's north; the attacker looks across its corner.
basis: p. 30 partial line of sight (confirmed); p. 38 cover; sampling U2/U16, readings U4, U5
ruling: Four of five test rays are stopped by the wall and one gets past its corner, so sight is Partial; the wall is between, touches the target and is wide enough, so it gives cover.
